<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <meta name="theme-color" content="#0b1731" />
  <title>Oblix — Digital Property Ownership by OneHomes</title>
  <meta name="description" content="Oblix client testing prototype for digital.onehomes.com — property seller onboarding, investor journeys, certificates and closed resale marketplace." />
  <link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml;base64," type="image/svg+xml" />
  <style>
:root{
  --ink:#101828;--muted:#667085;--line:#e4e7ec;--panel:#fff;--soft:#f7f9fc;--navy:#0b1731;--navy2:#14264b;
  --teal:#16a68c;--teal-soft:#e6f7f3;--blue:#2b6de9;--blue-soft:#eaf1ff;--gold:#ca8a04;--gold-soft:#fff7d9;
  --coral:#e96557;--coral-soft:#fff0ee;--purple:#7357d9;--purple-soft:#f1edff;--danger:#c43b3b;--ok:#087a5b;
  --shadow:0 16px 42px rgba(14,34,72,.10);--radius:20px;--radius-sm:13px;
  --serif:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;--sans:Montserrat,Inter,ui-sans-serif,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,Arial,sans-serif;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html{scroll-behavior:smooth}body{margin:0;background:#f4f7fb;color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--sans);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
button,input,select,textarea{font:inherit}button{cursor:pointer}.app-shell{min-height:100vh}.prototype-banner{background:#071126;color:#fff;padding:7px 18px;text-align:center;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.02em}.prototype-banner b{color:#71e0ce}
.topbar{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:30;background:rgba(255,255,255,.94);backdrop-filter:blur(18px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.topbar-inner{max-width:1260px;margin:auto;padding:14px 24px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:20px}.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-width:max-content}.brand-mark{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:12px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,var(--navy),var(--blue));display:grid;place-items:center;color:#fff;font-weight:800;box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(11,23,49,.18)}.brand-copy strong{display:block;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:18px}.brand-copy span{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.16em;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase}.nav{display:flex;gap:3px;flex:1;justify-content:center}.nav button{border:0;background:transparent;color:#344054;padding:10px 11px;border-radius:10px;font-size:13px}.nav button:hover,.nav button.active{background:#eef3fb;color:var(--navy)}.head-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}.pill,.badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--line);padding:6px 10px;font-size:12px;background:#fff}.badge.good{background:var(--teal-soft);border-color:#b9e8de;color:#08775f}.badge.warn{background:var(--gold-soft);border-color:#f3dd9d;color:#8a6200}.badge.info{background:var(--blue-soft);border-color:#c7d9ff;color:#2457b8}.badge.dark{background:var(--navy);border-color:var(--navy);color:#fff}.badge.danger{background:var(--coral-soft);border-color:#f3c0ba;color:#9e3328}
.icon-btn,.ghost-btn,.primary-btn,.secondary-btn,.danger-btn{border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);padding:10px 14px;font-weight:650;background:#fff;color:var(--ink);transition:.2s}.primary-btn{background:var(--navy);border-color:var(--navy);color:#fff}.primary-btn:hover{background:#14264b;transform:translateY(-1px)}.secondary-btn{background:var(--teal-soft);border-color:#b9e8de;color:#076c57}.danger-btn{background:#fff4f2;border-color:#f7c6bf;color:#a5392d}.ghost-btn:hover,.icon-btn:hover{background:#f6f8fb}.small{padding:7px 10px;font-size:12px}.role-switch{display:flex;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:3px;background:#f8fafc}.role-switch button{border:0;background:transparent;border-radius:9px;padding:7px 9px;font-size:12px}.role-switch button.active{background:#fff;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(15,31,58,.10)}
main{max-width:1260px;margin:auto;padding:28px 24px 80px}.hero{position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:30px;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#071126 0%,#11264c 55%,#127f81 120%);color:#fff;padding:62px 60px;min-height:470px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.08fr .92fr;gap:34px;align-items:center;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}.hero:after{content:"";position:absolute;width:460px;height:460px;border-radius:50%;right:-120px;top:-100px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(82,232,205,.28),rgba(82,232,205,0) 70%)}.hero h1{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:500;font-size:clamp(42px,6vw,72px);line-height:.98;margin:12px 0 20px;letter-spacing:-.035em}.hero p{font-size:17px;line-height:1.65;color:#d7e1f2;max-width:640px}.eyebrow{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:800;color:#78e2d0}.hero-actions{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:26px}.hero .primary-btn{background:#fff;color:var(--navy);border-color:#fff}.hero .ghost-btn{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);color:#fff;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.22)}.hero-visual{position:relative;z-index:2}.hero-card{background:rgba(255,255,255,.10);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);border-radius:25px;padding:20px;backdrop-filter:blur(10px)}.hero-image{height:245px;border-radius:18px;background:url('data:image/webp;base64,') center/cover}.hero-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px;margin-top:12px}.hero-stat{padding:12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-radius:14px}.hero-stat small{display:block;color:#c9d7eb;font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em}.hero-stat strong{display:block;margin-top:5px;font-size:16px}.trust-strip{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:12px;margin:18px 0 40px}.trust-item{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:16px}.trust-item b{display:block;font-size:13px}.trust-item span{display:block;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:4px;line-height:1.5}
.section-head{display:flex;align-items:end;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;margin:36px 0 18px}.section-head h2{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:34px;font-weight:500;margin:0}.section-head p{color:var(--muted);margin:5px 0 0;max-width:700px}.grid{display:grid;gap:18px}.grid-3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}.grid-2{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.grid-4{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}.card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(15,31,58,.04);overflow:hidden}.card-pad{padding:20px}.property-card{transition:.2s}.property-card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}.property-image{height:220px;background-size:cover;background-position:center;position:relative}.property-image:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 45%,rgba(4,15,34,.58))}.property-tags{position:absolute;z-index:2;left:14px;top:14px;display:flex;gap:7px}.property-location{position:absolute;z-index:2;left:16px;bottom:13px;color:#fff;font-size:12px}.property-card h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:500;font-size:26px;margin:0 0 5px}.muted{color:var(--muted)}.tiny{font-size:11px}.micro{font-size:10px}.stat-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px;margin-top:16px}.stat{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:11px}.stat small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em}.stat b{display:block;font-size:14px;margin-top:4px}.card-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:18px}.card-actions>*{flex:1}
.flow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);gap:10px}.flow-step{background:#fff;border:1px solid var
